scope: bounded static implementation review; no model forward or optimizer replay

checks.fresh_communication_only: Each population member deep-copies one inherited v28 private-all checkpoint, excludes the private action head, and independently resets the communication modules.
checks.population_copy_independence: Four agents use private types [0,1,0,1] but separate parameter objects and independent communication reset seeds.
checks.matched_partner_schedule: fixed_partners repeats (0,1),(2,3); rotating_partners alternates (0,1),(2,3) with (0,3),(2,1) on the same four-direction update budget.
checks.multi_partner_target: The target and training supports are disjoint 2-regular bipartite graphs with 12 edges; target evaluation requires both resource partners.
checks.condition_paired_fixtures: Both partner conditions use the same frozen world/photo/mask and uniform streams; only the partner schedule changes.
checks.no_training_shortcut: All eight ordered cross-private-type protocol scores, partner-pair scores, and recombination references are computed from saved endpoint arrays offline.
checks.formal_gate: Formal execution binds both production source hashes and inherited input hashes to preflight_qa.json.
checks.fixed_budget: All formal runs use 2400 population updates, 960 messages and 1920 resource actions per update, with no performance-based selection.

limitations: The four population members reuse two frozen private encoders; this tests partner scheduling around controlled private variation rather than natural demographic variation.
The rotating schedule compares reuse and partner turnover in a fixed four-agent population; it does not model birth, death, migration, or cultural transmission.
The controlled task is a symbolic resource-location protocol with a multi-partner target, not a reconstruction of complete human ecology.
The bounded audit replays all endpoint sender worlds and receiver code tables and selected fixture traces, but not every gradient or Adam transition.
The 199 complete-code relabelings are a descriptive structural reference and do not establish autonomous compositionality.
